profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Booz Allen Hamilton

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Data Engineering · Redis · Image Sensors · Sensors · Gitlab · Linux · Red Hat Linux · Decision Trees · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed back-end services for data lake supporting the DRTF at Coast Guard from scratch
•	Created user information system and REST endpoints to process and transform data
•	Created asset system from the ground up to support tracking of personnel and material assets
•	Created notional datasets to support application testing
positions.insights: Skills: GWT · Neo4j · Data Lakes · Docker · Core Java · Java · Node.js · Git · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PostgreSQL · JSON

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed and maintained new features in a web-based data visualization software using tech stack including as Google Web Toolkit, NodeJS, H2 DB, Postgres, and AWS
•	Redesigned multiple parts of the GUI and updated legacy code to ensure cross browser support
•	Finalized and delivered version updates to clients, assisted in writing up documentation for user guides
•	Created new logging and user management systems from scratch and connected them to preexisting software
•	Worked on a data visualization software for an FDA project involving Neo4J, H2 database using d3
positions.insights: Skills: GWT · Neo4j · Java · Node.js · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed NLP solution using semantic role labeling, statistical topic modeling, and entity extraction and disambiguation on high volumes of unstructured and structured text
•	Improved and optimized an entity disambiguation tool aimed to automatically extract entities from multi-source datasets and model them with attributes and relationships
•	Developed back-end database structures and front-end RESTful web service
•	Delivered solution to clients via Docker, setting up mini Accumulo clusters and pre-ingested datasets
•	Contributed to writing multiple SBIR proposals on topics such as multiple target motion tracking through unsupervised feature learning with convolutional neural networks
positions.insights: Skills: Docker Products · Natural Language Processing (NLP) · Java · Apache Spark · Hadoop · Accumulo

positions.title: Software Product Developer
positions.description: Design, development, implementation, testing of interfaces for clients , extracting/interpreting data from web services and shaping data to fit the company's system.
